contract.scope: feature profiles and a11y-extras table semantics

roles.read: step, enumerated L0/ADR, pinned vanilla, final baseline
skill, step, final baseline/receipts, enumerated final nucleus/L0
roles.environment: shared checkout; protocol allowlist, no strong isolation

roles.forbidden: baseline, manifest, contract, oracle or attack edits

status_lattice.Preserved: Valid bilateral executions preserve the registered public observable.
status_lattice.Violated: A valid decisive execution or mutation witnesses mismatch or a forbidden outcome.
status_lattice.Unknown: Identity, provenance, parser, fixture, tool or execution opacity prevents decision.
rules: Disabled-by-profile receives no Preserved or MATCH credit.
Active-profile inability is Violated when decisive and Unknown when opaque; never disabled.
Only deliberately opaque cases may satisfy expected Unknown.

observables.claim: Default set empty; html and a11y bindings absent; target/format never activates features.
html and a11y-extras are independent; each active profile exposes only its gated surface.
Repeat, order, separate/comma flags are idempotent and deterministic; unknown feature is an argument error.
The a11y trio is indivisible: table-summary, header-cell and data-cell appear together only when active.
table-summary replaces only summary; omission removes /Summary; empty string stays present.
Explicit summary:none is error `expected string, found none`; only omission maps to absence.
All measured summary diagnostics preserve missing table, table cast, named-only and string cast semantics.
header-cell defaults level=1/scope=column, accepts row/column/both, requires positive integer and preserves existing cell fields.
data-cell accepts raw content or existing cell, preserves fields, forces Data, and preserves measured diagnostics.
Simple tagged table is Table>TR>TD in logical order.
Uniform automatic header is one THead plus one TBody with correct TH/TD header references.
Explicit mixed row remains direct TR; explicit Data inside header remains TD.
Row/Column/Both scopes, rowspan/colspan and nearest applicable level relations survive; level is not a numeric PDF attribute.
Tags enabled emit one StructTreeRoot, MarkInfo Marked=true/Suspects=false and balanced marked content.
Tags disabled omit table structure, ParentTree and MCIDs while preserving visual/textual observables.
MCIDs restart per page; StructParents and ParentTree preserve local order without duplicates or orphans.
Multipage keeps one logical table/header identity; repeated visual headers do not duplicate THead, TH IDs or relations.
Metadata-only change preserves text, pages, boxes, bbox and raster for frozen fixtures.
Frozen plain/a11y pair is byte-equal in HTML/SVG/PNG without generalization.
Forward/reverse and repetition agree; every probe has one classification and totals close exactly.
AT, screen-reader navigation, reflow, PDF/UA and certification remain Unknown.
Bundle behavior and undecoded PDF objects/relations remain Unknown and receive no success credit.

mandatory_attack_obligations: A01 reject HTML on by default
A02 reject HTML target implicitly enabling a feature
A03 reject a11y-extras on by default
A04 reject html enabling a11y-extras
A05 reject a11y-extras enabling html
A06 reject accepted-but-ignored flag
A07 reject registration of only data-cell
A08 reject bindings present without feature
A09 reject body-returning metadata-discarding stub
A10 reject summary lost before builder
A11 reject Header converted to Data
A12 reject explicit Data promoted inside header
A13 reject row/column scope swap
A14 reject ignored level or accepted zero
A15 reject duplicate MCID
A16 reject orphan ParentTree/StructElem
A17 reject tags emitted when disabled
A18 reject visual/text change from metadata
A19 reject disabled counted as MATCH/Preserved
A20 reject unknown active flag classified disabled
A21 reject forward/reverse divergence
A22 reject ignored manifest/baseline/fixture/nucleus/L0 drift
invalidation: Unknown or disabled promoted to success
